questions.prompt_html: \text{设} \, y = \sqrt { x } e ^ { \frac { x } { 2 } } \, , \, \text{则} \, y ^ { \prime } ( x ) = \ \ [ \quad \, ] .

options.label: B
options.html: \left( \frac { 2 } { \sqrt { x } } - \frac { \sqrt { x } } { 2 } \right) e ^ { \frac { x } { 2 } } \ .

options.label: C
options.html: \left( \frac { 2 } { \sqrt { x } } + \frac { \sqrt { x } } { 2 } \right) e ^ { \frac { x } { 2 } } ;

questions.analysis_html: \text{解答} \ y'(x) = \frac{1}{2\sqrt{x}}e^{\frac{x}{2}} + \sqrt{x}\frac{1}{2}e^{\frac{x}{2}} = \left( \frac{1}{2\sqrt{x}} + \frac{\sqrt{x}}{2} \right)e^{\frac{x}{2}}

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}&\text{解答 若（1）成立，则}f'(x)\equiv 0,\text{可得在} (a,b)\text{内}f(x)\equiv C,\text{又因为在}[a,b]\text{上连续，所以}f(x)\equiv f(a);\text{若}\\&\text{(2)成立，有}f(x)\equiv f(a),\text{求导得}f'(x)\equiv 0,\text{可得（1）成立。所以（1）是（2）的充分必要条件.}\end{aligned}

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}&\frac{d\left(\sin x^2\right)}{d\left(\sqrt{x}\right)}=\frac{2x\cos x^2dx}{\frac{1}{2\sqrt{x}}dx}=4x\sqrt{x}\cos x^2\\&\therefore d\left(\sin x^2\right)=\left(4x\sqrt{x}\cos x^2\right)d\left(\sqrt{x}\right)\\&d\left(\frac{e^{2x}}{x^2}\right)=\frac{x^2d\left(e^{2x}\right)-e^{2x}dx^2}{\left(x^2\right)^2}=\frac{x^2e^{2x}2dx-e^{2x}2xdx}{\left(x^2\right)^2}=\frac{2e^{2x}(x-1)}{x^3}dx\\&d\left(\frac{1}{\omega}\sin \omega x+1\right)=\frac{1}{\omega}\left(\sin \omega x\right)'dx=\cos \omega xdx\\&d\left[\ln \left(x+\sqrt{x^2+1}\right)\right]=\frac{1}{x+\sqrt{x^2+1}}d\left(x+\sqrt{x^2+1}\right)\\&=\frac{1}{x+\sqrt{x^2+1}}\left(1+\frac{x}{\sqrt{x^2+1}}\right)dx=\frac{1}{\sqrt{x^2+1}}dx\end{aligned}
